column1: Merii-san wa basutei de basu o matte imasu,Mary is waiting for a bus at the bus stop.,メアリーさんは バスていで バスを まっています,sentence,,メアリーさん
column15: ongoing action: is …ing,まって います (matte imasu) means “is waiting.” で (de) marks where the action happens.

column1: Norio-san wa yasete imasu ga Yasuo-san wa futotte imasu,"Norio is thin, but Yasuo is fat.",ノリオさんは やせていますが、ヤスオさんは ふとっています,sentence,,ノリオさん
column17: current state: is,やせて います means “is thin”; ふとって います means “is heavy / fat.” These describe current states. が connects the clauses with “but.”

column1: Yasuo-san wa se ga takakunai desu,Yasuo is not tall.,ヤスオさんは せが たかくないです,sentence,,ヤスオさん
column11: polite ending,"せ が たかくない means “is not tall.” Literally, the person’s height is not high."

column1: Kyou Norio-san wa atarashii T-shatsu o kite imasu,"Today, Norio is wearing a new T-shirt.",きょう、ノリオさんは あたらしい てぃーしゃつを きています,sentence,,きょう
column15: current state: is wearing,"きょう (kyou) means “today.” きて います means “is wearing,” describing the current state."

column1: Yui-san no otousan wa ginkou de hataraite imasu,Yui's father works at a bank.,ユイさんの おとうさんは ぎんこうで はたらいています,sentence,,ユイさん
column15: ongoing action / current occupation,はたらいて います (hataraite imasu) means “works / is working.” の marks possession: Yui’s father.

column1: Yui-san no okaasan wa byouin de hataraite imasu,Yui's mother works at a hospital.,ユイさんの おかあさんは びょういんで はたらいています,sentence,,ユイさん
column15: ongoing action / current occupation,はたらいて います (hataraite imasu) means “works / is working.” で marks the workplace.

column1: Yui-san no oneesan wa kekkon shite imasu,Yui's older sister is married.,ユイさんの おねえさんは けっこんしています,sentence,,ユイさん
column13: current state,"けっこん して います (kekkon shite imasu) together means “is married,” a current state."

column1: Yui-san no otouto wa Nagano ni sunde imasu,Yui's younger brother lives in Nagano.,ユイさんの おとうとは ながのに すんでいます,sentence,,ユイさん
column15: current state,すんで います (sunde imasu) means “lives / is living.” おとうと (otouto) means “younger brother.”

column1: yasukute oishii,cheap and delicious,やすくて おいしい,sentence,That restaurant's food is cheap. It is delicious.,やすくて
column3: delicious,"やすい (yasui, cheap) becomes やすくて (yasukute) to join it to the next adjective: “cheap and delicious.”"

column1: chiisakute kawaii,small and cute,ちいさくて かわいい,sentence,My cat is very small. It is cute.,ちいさくて
column3: cute,"ちいさい (chiisai, small) becomes ちいさくて (chiisakute): “small and cute.”"

column1: shizuka de tsumaranai,quiet and boring,しずかで つまらない,sentence,My town is quiet. It is boring.,しずか
column5: boring,しずか is a na-adjective. Add で to join it to another description: “quiet and boring.”

column1: furukute omoshiroi,old and interesting,ふるくて おもしろい,sentence,This temple is old. It is interesting.,ふるくて
column3: interesting,"ふるい (furui, old) becomes ふるくて (furukute): “old and interesting.”"

column1: Oosaka ni tomodachi ni ai ni ikimasu,I go to Osaka to meet a friend.,おおさかに ともだちに あいに いきます,sentence,,おおさか
column13: go (polite),あい に いきます (ai ni ikimasu) means “go to meet.” ともだち に marks whom you meet; おおさか に marks the destination.

column1: Kinou Nihonmachi ni hon o kai ni ikimashita,"Yesterday, I went to Japantown to buy a book.",きのう、にほんまちに ほんを かいに いきました,sentence,,きのう
column15: went (polite past),"かい に (kai ni) means “in order to buy.” かい is the stem of かう (kau, buy). ほん を かい に いきました means “went to buy a book.”"
